description: This Java class, DatabaseUrlEnvironmentPostProcessor, is a Spring Boot EnvironmentPostProcessor that maps common PostgreSQL URL environment variables (like DATABASE_URL) into Spring Boot's datasource properties. It parses database URLs, converts them into JDBC URLs, and sets the appropriate environment properties to configure database connections dynamically, especially in cloud or hosting environments.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlEnvironmentPostProcessor
classes.description: A Spring Boot environment post-processor that detects environment variables for PostgreSQL URLs and converts them into Spring Boot datasource properties, ensuring proper database connectivity configuration.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the execution order of this post-processor, set to run early in the environment processing chain.

methods.name: postProcessEnvironment
methods.description: Main logic to modify the environment by injecting datasource properties based on environment variables.

methods.name: firstNonBlank
methods.description: Returns the first non-blank string from the provided list of strings.

methods.name: parseToJdbc
methods.description: Parses a given database URL string into a JDBC URL and extracts username/password if present.

methods.name: ensureSslMode
methods.description: Ensures that the JDBC URL includes 'sslmode=require', appending it if missing.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses the query string from a URI into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: Encodes strings into application/x-www-form-urlencoded format using UTF-8.
